messages:
ricardo: Heads-up — we need to kick off GPU capacity procurement for a new cluster in southamerica-east1 (Sao Paulo). Planning window: next 6 weeks. Who can own quota requests + reservation?

maya: I can drive the quota ticket but need the exact SKU counts and tentative start date. do we want on-demand reserve or committed monthly? :thinking_face: 

sam: For bring-up we usually request reservations for initial 2 weeks to validate autoscaling, then convert to committed if utilization justifies. recommend 16x A100-80GB for the first stage.

jin: 16 A100-80GB sounds right. Also need to confirm VPC/peering and that the private control plane can reach the region (VPN tunnel + Cloud Router). network team ok?

leah: Network: we need a preflight checklist. NATs and egress paths might cost more in sa-east1. I'll run a quick audit of expected egress. Also, confirm whether HSM/KMS key access will be zonal.

ricardo: Good call. Cost-ballpark: 16 x A100-80GB reserved short-term =~ $35k/month raw infra (cloud list rates), + egress. add 10-15% for support/overhead. Put that in the ticket.

maya: I'll open the provider ticket. Drafting quota payload below — feel free to copy: 

```json
{
  "project": "redwood-prod",
  "region": "southamerica-east1",
  "resources": [
    {"type": "GPU_NVIDIA_A100_80GB", "count": 16},
    {"type": "n1-standard-32", "count": 16}
  ],
  "start_window": "2026-05-10",
  "end_window": "2026-05-24",
  "purpose": "New cluster bring-up for inference staging -> validate autoscaling and latency SLOs",
  "billing_owner": "ricardo@redwood.ai",
  "contact": "maya@redwood.ai"
}
```

jin: Also include a note to enable quota for sustained usage and ask for temporary soft reservation if possible. Some providers accept a "capacity hold" request.

cloud-support: FYI — GCP usually wants expected QPS and per-node CPU/memory footprint. Add the per-node profile: `cpu: 32, mem: 240GB, disk: 1TB` and expected concurrent sessions ~= 2500.

sam: Adding the validation tests we'll run after capacity is available: 
- smoke: cluster bootstrap + scheduler join (10 nodes) 
- perf: 1000 concurrent short gen requests (seq_len 128) 
- kv-cache: warm prefix cache and measure hit rate >= 70% 
- fallback: route 10% traffic to smaller model variant and ensure <2% error increase

leah: Handoff checklist for oncall: 
- confirm quota approved and reservation ID (ticket link) 
- provide list of node hostnames / instance IDs 
- share firewall rules + VPC subnets 
- SSH bastion credentials and jump host IPs (rotate after handoff) 
- who is billing approver (ricardo)

ricardo: tag the ticket `bringup:sa-east1` and `priority:high`. also include compliance note: we will not route user PII during validation — use synthetic prompts only.

maya: Opened ticket with support: https://console.cloud.provider/support/requests/CH-123456789 (placeholder) — added payload and cost estimate. Pinged provider account rep for expedited review.

ops-bot: Deploy-bot noticed a quota shortfall in prod-sao last night; alert created -> QRT-98765. Recommend we attach that alert to the ticket as historical evidence.

jin: Next steps for infra team: 
1) maya: follow up with provider for reservation ID and ETA (target 48h) 
2) sam: prepare cluster bootstrap terraform plan and a `bringup.tfvars` with the reserved counts 
3) leah: run network preflight and post results to the ticket 
4) ricardo: approve billing once we have final quote 

sam: Terraform snippet for the reservation region var: 
```hcl
variable "region" { default = "southamerica-east1" }
resource "google_compute_instance_template" "infer_instance" {
  machine_type = "n1-standard-32"
  guest_accelerator { type = "nvidia-tesla-a100", count = 1 }
}
```

maya: Provider replied — asking for SLA justification and start date confirmation. They can reserve within 72h after approval. I asked for a soft hold until end of month.

leah: Note on networking gotcha: Cloud NAT egress billing in sa-east1 bills per-region; for benchmarking use a NAT in the same region to avoid cross-region egress spikes. Also, route monitoring must be enabled on the private control plane.

ricardo: If provider can't reserve full 16, what's our fallback? Sam, plan for 8-node initial subset and stagger node boot to validate autoscaling under partial capacity.

sam: Will do. I'll add a `scale_down` fallback policy and an A/B rollout tag so we can fallback to hosted-api if latency degrades.

maya: Closing loop: I'll update ticket with fallback plan and ask provider for reservation ID and effective window. Will post updates here. :thumbsup:

ricardo: Thanks. Once reservation ID is in, @oncall please schedule a 1hr handoff meeting with the release engineers.

cloud-support: Added a note to the ticket about quota verification steps and what logs provider will share on approval.

maya: Ticket updated with reservation ID placeholder CH-123456789-RESERVE once confirmed. I'll ping again when confirmed.

ricardo: Great work team — keep the thread lean. We'll follow-up in the handoff meeting. :rocket:
